en: Colorized view of a large historic castle complex rising above dense trees. The building has thick stone walls, several round towers with conical and domed roofs, and an adjoining long white wing with a red-tiled roof and dormer windows. The sky is blue with a few clouds. At the top left, printed text reads "Wurzen. Schloss." indicating the depicted castle in the town of Wurzen.
